name: Sour
source: A Sour type monster girl. Sour monster girls look like magical girls or cute witches. This Sour type monster girl was captured by [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] who sexually tortured her in order to force her to kill [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url]. She's defeated by [url=http://vndb.org/c13594]Valkyrie[/url] and then tamed by Leo.
